content.title: Muslims Day: Your Everyday Partner in Deen.
content.subtitle: To continue serving millions without pause, we need you today.
content.body:
Truth be told, we never imagined we could successfully complete two massive campaigns back-to-back in such a short span of time. The monumental goals of reciting 10 million Darood in 10 days and 10 million Istighfar in 10 days were achieved well ahead of schedule—all because of your dedication.

Deeply Indebted to Your Love

Your overwhelming response to these campaigns left us truly humbled. Day after day, our support inbox overflowed with hundreds of heartfelt messages. Many of you shared how this initiative helped build a profound daily habit of worship, urging us to bring forward such campaigns time and again. It is your sincere love and tireless effort that brought us this far. While our ultimate gratitude belongs to Allah, our hearts are overflowing with thankfulness for each and every one of you.

Our True Purpose: Nurturing a Habit of Amal

Yet, reaching a numerical milestone was never the true objective of this initiative. Our core purpose was to instill a lasting habit of worship—especially for those of us who struggle to maintain regular Darood and Istighfar amidst life's relentless rush. If this entire effort brings meaningful change to the lives of even ten individuals and transforms these acts into daily routines, our hard work is fully fulfilled. Our aspiration is to help every soul become "a slightly better Muslim today than they were yesterday."

The Reality of Daily Upkeep and Behind-the-Scenes Challenges

Your unwavering support fuels our courage. We hold onto the vision of reaching millions of Muslims across the globe with the message of Deen, guiding each person toward continuous spiritual growth. Turning this vision into reality is a dedicated team of 15 to 20 members working day and night. Delivering this service seamlessly to millions is a colossal undertaking. From heavy engineering and high-end server maintenance to outreach campaigns and office operations, every step incurs substantial, ongoing financial costs.

The Quiet Sacrifices of Our "Ansar"

To shoulder these ongoing operational expenses and keep this noble service sustainable, we envisioned a dedicated circle of 2,000 "Ansar"—fellow believers who would each contribute just 500 BDT per month to share the responsibility of this platform with us. By the grace of Allah, 620 sincere brothers and sisters have already stepped forward and joined hands as Ansar.

Will You Walk the Rest of This Journey With Us?

To complete our family of 2,000 Ansar, we still need around 1,380 devoted companions. If you have the means, we warmly invite you to become an "Ansar" and take part in this spiritual transformation of the Ummah.

footer_button.hint: A humble contribution of just 500 BDT a month can become an enduring Sadaqah Jariyah for you, carrying the reward of millions engaging in good deeds. Join us today as an Ansar and become an integral part of this blessed mission.
footer_button.text: I want to become a Muslims Day Ansar.
